phases.description: Per-phase breakdown keyed by workflow phase name.

bucket.description: Time + cost accumulated for one phase (or the grand total).

cache_read.description: Cached input tokens read (cheaper on some vendors, e.g. Anthropic ~0.1x).

cache_write.description: Cache-creation input tokens written (pricier on some vendors, e.g. Anthropic ~1.25x).

tokens_total.description: All tokens processed (uncached in + cached read/write + out).

credits.description: GitHub AI credits consumed (may be fractional).

cost_usd.description: Direct dollar cost, if the agent/tool reports one (best signal).
